extracted.name: Turmeric-ginger marinade
extracted.description: Slather this turmeric-ginger marinade on chicken wings or tofu overnight. Turmeric, like ginger, is a root and grows in India and South East Asia
instruction_lines: Toast the turmeric and chilli powder in a dry frying pan. Mix with the grated ginger, garlic cloves and vegetable oil. Season.
